newsitem.title: UK: British Airways up, SBC Warburg rates "buy".
newsitem.headline: British Airways up, SBC Warburg rates "buy".

text.p: Shares in British Airways Plc rose on Thursday as analysts at SBC Warburg repeated both a "buy" rating and a 600p price target for the stock, traders said on Thursday.
The stock was up 13-1/2p at 540 by 1037 GMT in active trade of 4.2 million shares -- making it the second most active FTSE 100 stock.
Analysts at Warburg were not available for comment.
Traders said the stock had also been boosted by BA's announcement this week that it planned to shed 5,000 of its 49,000 UK staff under a three-year restructuring programme.
They noted the stock had recently lagged the rest of the UK market, partly because of fears its planned alliance with American Airlines would not gain regulatory approval.
"People like rationalisations," said one market-maker, "and the stock has underperformed over the last couple of months."
British Airways shares are trading below their record close of 570p set on May 22.
